parts.title: Looking back
parts.intro: Three times each: what worked for you, what you wish had been different, and what might happen if a rule changed.

parts.title: Checking the game against the world
parts.intro: Pick two numbers the game used, check them against a source, and answer the six questions from the debrief with the record in hand.

items.prompt: First number: which one, your source, and does it agree?
Second number: which one, your source, and does it agree?
When equity rose, was it because shares narrowed or because there was more water?
Which measure of fairness did you believe, and why?
What happened when Drip was followed by Expand?
Which arguments did the table use in the dry season?
What did the aquifer do over the game, and why?
The lens you voted for and the lens the water as used came closest to: what explains the gap?

parts.title: One recommendation
parts.intro: One rule you would recommend for a real basin.

items.prompt: Your recommendation, and who loses under it.
